policies.title: Enterprise outage SLA
policies.snippet: Enterprise customers reporting a full service outage must be set to P1 and escalated to the infra on-call within 15 minutes.

policies.title: Billing dispute handling
policies.snippet: Billing disputes (double charge, wrong amount) are routed to the billing queue at P2. Refund eligibility is checked before any credit.

policies.title: Refund request window
policies.snippet: Refund requests within 30 days are routed to the refunds queue at P3. Outside the window requires lead approval.

policies.title: Account access default
policies.snippet: Account/login issues (non-outage) default to the account queue at P3.

policies.title: Shipping inquiry default
policies.snippet: Shipping/delivery inquiries default to the logistics queue at P4 unless lost/damaged, then P3.

policies.title: Angry / churn-risk escalation
policies.snippet: Tickets with strong negative sentiment or explicit cancellation threats are bumped one priority level and flagged for lead review.

policies.title: Uncategorised default
policies.snippet: Tickets that do not match a known category are routed to the general queue at P3 for manual triage.
